# Rig local API v1

<!-- Generated by `python3 scripts/local_api.py doc`; do not edit. -->

JSON-RPC 2.0, one JSON object per line, over `api.sock` in the private runtime
directory. Start it with `rig api serve`. Each request carries `token` (the
contents of `api.token` beside the socket, mode 0600). Every response carries
`"rig_api": 1`. A method returns `{"text": ...}` plus `json` when the text
parses as a JSON object or array and `structured` when the tool returns a
structured result (queue items, recovery guidance). Tool errors
are JSON-RPC errors with code -32000. `repo` in params is ignored: the server is bound to one
repository. Owner tokens are never returned, and workers may not serve the API.

| Method | Mutates | MCP tool | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `doctor` | no | `rig_doctor` | Readiness report |
| `job.allow` | yes | `rig_job_allow` | Allow a worker's pending command |
| `job.cancel` | yes | `rig_job_cancel` | Request a job stop; not confirmation |
| `job.deny` | yes | `rig_job_deny` | Deny a worker's pending command |
| `job.message` | yes | `rig_job_message` | Send a message to a running worker |
| `jobs.list` | no | `rig_jobs` | List running and recent jobs |
| `jobs.log` | no | `rig_job_log` | Read a job's log |
| `jobs.show` | no | `rig_job_show` | Show one job |
| `queue.add` | yes | `rig_queue_add` | Park a task in the queue |
| `queue.cancel` | yes | `rig_queue_cancel` | Cancel a pending queue item |
| `queue.list` | no | `rig_queue_list` | List queue items |
| `recovery.guide` | no | `rig_recovery_guide` | Recorded recovery evidence for a job or workflow |
| `session` | no | `rig_session` | Routing and session view for a case |
| `status` | no | `rig_status` | Parent and worker availability |
| `workflows.list` | no | `rig_workflows` | List workflows |
| `workflows.show` | no | `rig_workflow_show` | Show one workflow |
| `api.methods` | no | none | List the methods this server offers |
| `api.ping` | no | none | Check the server and protocol version |
| `applies.hold` | yes | none | Hold a job's branch so the parent's acceptance does not merge it, or release it (params: id, on) |
| `applies.redo` | yes | none | Apply an undone job again (params: id) |
| `applies.today` | no | none | Done today: the helpers' work applied, undone or held, newest first |
| `applies.undo` | yes | none | Undo an applied job: revert its merge commit on its base branch (params: id) |
| `board.snapshot` | no | none | Board data (jobs window, pending queue, slots, settings, workflows) plus a ready-to-render `view` |
| `chat.answer` | yes | none | Allow or deny the parent's pending permission request in a chat session (params: session, ask_id, decision) |
| `chat.cancel` | yes | none | EXPERIMENT: stop a chat session's running turn (params: session) |
| `chat.commands` | no | none | The parent's own skills and slash commands, for the shell's / menu (params: parent) |
| `chat.fork` | yes | none | EXPERIMENT: start a new chat session that begins as a copy of this one up to a turn (params: session, turn) |
| `chat.models` | no | none | Every model the parent CLI lists or Rig knows for it, for the shell's /model (params: parent) |
| `chat.parent` | yes | none | Name the project's parent CLI in .rig/harness.toml, as rig use does (params: name) |
| `chat.rewind` | yes | none | EXPERIMENT: put the working tree back as it was before a chat turn (params: session, turn, path, dry, undo) |
| `chat.search` | no | none | EXPERIMENT: the chat sessions whose messages contain the words of a query (params: query) |
| `chat.send` | yes | none | EXPERIMENT: send one message to the headless parent; the answer arrives in the transcript (params: message, session, parent) |
| `chat.status` | no | none | EXPERIMENT: whether the headless-parent chat is on, which parents can run, and recent sessions |
| `chat.steer` | yes | none | EXPERIMENT: interrupt a chat session's running turn with a message the parent goes on from (params: session, message) |
| `chat.transcript` | no | none | EXPERIMENT: a chat session's transcript (params: session, tail) |
| `env.recover` | yes | none | Apply the confirmed environment recovery step once, if it is safe (params: confirm_id) |
| `env.recovery` | no | none | The one next step dc-cli proposes for an environment fault, and whether Rig would apply it |
| `env.shell` | no | none | The dc exec --no-start command for an interactive shell in a job's container, or why there is none (params: id) |
| `events.ack` | yes | none | Acknowledge one notice, or all, for a companion session |
| `events.list` | no | none | Notices for a companion session: approvals, finished work, verification, stop progress |
| `fleet.status` | no | none | Fleet panel: workspace containers on the engine with observed CPU and memory, ready to render |
| `job.diff` | no | none | What one job changed, as a unified diff with per-file counts (params: id) |
| `job.evidence` | no | none | Evidence drawer for one job: where it ran, change, contract, checks, ports (params: id) |
| `job.pause` | yes | none | Pause a running helper (SIGSTOP to its process group) or let it go on (params: id, on) |
| `job.problems` | no | none | Problems a job's failed checks found (file, line, severity, message); no id: the newest job with any (params: id) |
| `job.thread` | no | none | A helper's thread with the parent: its brief, what it did, messages, its question and result (params: id) |
| `log.follow` | no | none | Tail of a job's log as plain text; without an id, the job worth watching (params: id, lines) |
| `settings.app` | no | none | The board's Settings screen: the values it can change and where each is kept |
| `settings.set` | yes | none | Change one of the board's settings (params: key, value, scope all|repo) |
| `settings.view` | no | none | Settings tab: what this repository's .rig/harness.toml makes effective, ready to render and read-only |
| `shell.doctor` | no | none | What is wrong with this project in plain words, each finding with the safe fix Rig can run (id, level, title, detail, fix) |
| `shell.fix` | yes | none | Run one safe fix a shell.doctor finding named (params: fix) |
| `shell.parent` | no | none | The command that runs the parent CLI in a board pane, or why there is none (params: parent) |
| `shell.selftest` | yes | none | Start a self-test in the background: tiny real turns per installed parent (answer, reasoning level, model, plan, auto-edit, stop), in a throwaway project; it costs what short prompts cost (params: parents) |
| `shell.selftest_status` | no | none | The self-test's report as far as it has got (state, running, parents with checks) |
| `ship.run` | yes | none | Push what is ahead, or open a pull request with gh (params: mode push|pr, title, body) |
| `ship.status` | no | none | What is ahead of the upstream branch, and the pull request it would make |
| `ui.request` | yes | none | Companion operations (snapshot, enqueue, stop, reply, details, sessions) on the hosted UI service |
| `ui.set_theme` | yes | none | Keep the board's colour theme for all repos or this repo (params: theme, scope all|repo) |
| `ui.theme` | no | none | The board's colour theme and where it is kept (all repos or this repo) |
| `workspace.status` | no | none | Workspace panel: container, ports and dc-cli diagnosis as ready-to-render sections (params: deep) |
